replacement.service_identity: dedicated echo-guardian-beta OS and peer-authenticated PostgreSQL roles
replacement.write_credential: dedicated value-only systemd credential; no sovereign key reuse

provenance.relationship: The inventory hash covers canonical rescued deployed JavaScript, the normalized-bundle hash covers the recovered Worker bundle, the repository hash covers preserved TypeScript source, and the D1 hash covers rescued state. Each identity is verified independently; no byte-equivalence claim is made between distinct artifacts.

non_generic_route_coverage.evidence: The preserved Beta src/index.ts is byte-identical to the independently migrated Alpha route source. Fourteen total path literals were enumerated structurally; excluding / and /health leaves twelve non-generic routes, all present in this runtime.

bindings.DB: PostgreSQL schema cf_echo_guardian_beta, seeded from the hash-pinned D1 artifact with declared INTEGER/TEXT affinities preserved
bindings.SVC_ENGINE_RUNTIME: deliberately removed from autonomous mutation; private targets are probed directly
bindings.SVC_SHARED_BRAIN: runtime report is persisted locally; the scoped builder lane performs the verified SDK registration
bindings.SVC_PARTNER: echo-guardian-alpha identity retained; optional probe remains unset until its exact private endpoint is approved

deliberate_deltas: All non-health HTTP routes are private and require constant-time bearer authentication.
Fleet fan-out is bounded and limited to allowlisted private-cluster targets.
Automatic source, deploy, repository, worker-creation, and partner-resurrection mutations are disabled; candidates are queued for review.
Systemd timers replace the Worker scheduled handler and add jitter plus single-flight advisory locks.
Cloudflare and GitHub write credentials are not required by the replacement runtime.
The imported 144-worker manifest is retained; only configured private-cluster targets are actively probed.
Shared Brain reporting is completed by the scoped builder registration path, not an embedded privileged runtime client.
Partner recovery remains disabled until an exact private Alpha endpoint and approved deploy gate are registered.
